text:
mira: starting a quick coldstart probe across regions for bring-up notes. testing q4a/q8a for qwen/mistral/llama, seq=8k and 32k. focus: cold KV cache, kernel fallbacks, and p95 jitter.
alex: nice. which GPUs/regions? can we hit eu + apac with H100 and A100? :eyes: 
sam: i'll run parallel small-runs. going to use bench v2 with --coldstart flag.
jia: callouts: qwen seems to prefer gqa-kernel-v2, mistral hits rope-legacy path, llama sometimes falls back to ctx-interop. watch for implicit kernel fallthroughs.
mira: exactly. start with these commands for parity check:
```
./bench/run_bench --model qwen-7b --quant q4a --seq 8192 --gpu h100 --region eu-west1 --concurrency 12 --coldstart
./bench/run_bench --model mistral-8x --quant q4a --seq 8192 --gpu a100 --region asia-east1 --concurrency 12 --coldstart
./bench/run_bench --model llama-2-13b --quant q4a --seq 8192 --gpu h100 --region eu-west1 --concurrency 12 --coldstart
```
kevin: heads-up: set --kernel-fallback=off for one run so we can see raw kernel errors, then do default run. also capture `--kv-hit-stats`.
alex: i'll kick off with that kernel-fallback off.
eval-bot: run queued: 2019999999-1 qwen-7b H100 eu-west1 q4a seq8192 conc12 --coldstart. ETA ~6m.
sam: initial small summary (raw):
```
MODEL,GPU,REGION,SEQ,TP50(ms),TP95(ms),QPS,KV_HIT
qwen-7b,H100,eu-west1,8192,17,46,230,0.08
mistral-8x,A100,asia-east1,8192,21,63,190,0.06
llama-2-13b,H100,eu-west1,8192,19,72,170,0.04
```
mira: interesting: llama p95 is high even with H100. looks like a fallback/slow kernel path kicking in under coldstart. Jia, can you triage kernel selection logs?
jia: digging in — i see `rope-legacy` for llama at step ~1200 tokens, then `ctx-interop` fallthrough when seq windows exceed 4k. adding the logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T12:02:11Z] kernel_select: llama-2-13b -> rope-legacy (ok)
[2026-03-18T12:02:12Z] kernel_select: llama-2-13b -> ctx-interop (fallthrough due to seglen>4096)
[2026-03-18T12:02:12Z] exec: ctx-interop slower path, extra memcpy observed
```
kevin: that memcpy matches the p95 spike. quant artifacts may be amplifying the cost because of extra reorder ops. try same runs with q8a to compare.
alex: kicked q8a jobs now. 
eval-bot: run queued: 2019999999-2 qwen-7b H100 eu-west1 q8a seq8192 conc12 --coldstart. ETA ~6m.
sam: q8a raw results (trimmed):
```
qwen-7b,H100,eu-west1,8192,15,38,260,0.09
mistral-8x,A100,asia-east1,8192,18,52,215,0.07
llama-2-13b,H100,eu-west1,8192,17,48,200,0.05
```
mira: q8a helps a lot for p95 across the board; llama's fallthrough still visible but less penalty. suggests quantization interacts with kernel dispatch heuristics.
jia: proposal: add a lightweight check in kernel selector to prefer gqa-kernel-v2 for Qwen-like models when seq>4k AND quant level >= q4a. also flag `--force-gqa` for manual runs.
kevin: agree. also add perf counters around memcpy and reorder to validate the hypothesis.
sam: also saw region delta: apac runs on A100 had ~10-12% higher p95 compared to eu H100 even when QPS similar. suspect PCIe topology and instance sizing differences.
alex: can we size capacity plans with these numbers? if p95 on H100 q8a is ~38ms for qwen 7b at 12 conc, QPS=260, that's ~21k tokens/sec? math check.
mira: we should produce a short table for capacity sizing and canary rollout thresholds. i'll create a tiny PR with the summary and suggested kernel toggle.
eval-bot: summary artifact posted: s3://redwood-evals/2019999999/coldstart-probe/summary.csv
jia: one-more-note: for 32k seq tests we need to run longer to warm KV; expect lower QV hit initially which will exaggerate coldstart. schedule tomorrow.
kevin: thumbs up. next actions: (1) mirror runs with --force-gqa, (2) add memcpy perf counters, (3) run 32k coldstart in eu + apac, (4) draft canary flag. :thumbsup:
mira: thanks team — will coordinate follow-ups in the PR and mark for oncall review if kernel change is risky.
alex: nice work, flagged in roadmap board. :rocket:
